toolsIndex.title: Free calculators for Albania
toolsIndex.intro: Accurate, free calculators built around Albanian rules. No signup, no limits. Pick the one you need.
toolsIndex.metaDescription: Free calculators for Albania: net and gross salary, self-employed take-home, and loan and mortgage installments. No signup, no limits.

cards.salary: Net pay from gross, gross from net, and the full employer cost, with income tax and social and health insurance.
cards.freelancer: Your take-home as a freelancer, with the 0% profit tax, the fixed monthly contributions and the VAT threshold.
cards.loan: Monthly installment on a loan or mortgage, total interest, a fixed then variable rate, rate rises and early repayment.

toolsIndex.ctaText: Want to track your income, spending and goals in one place, not just calculate them?

freelancerCalc.title: Self-Employed Tax Calculator (Albania {{year}})
freelancerCalc.intro: What do you actually keep as a freelancer in Albania? Contributions are fixed amounts, not a percentage of income, and profit tax is 0% until {{until}} if you meet the conditions.
freelancerCalc.metaDescription: Self-employed calculator for Albania {{year}}. Work out your take-home with the 0% freelancer profit tax, the fixed monthly contributions and the VAT threshold.
freelancerCalc.annualHint: Calculated as monthly x 12. If your work is seasonal, enter the annual figure directly.
freelancerCalc.adminHint: Your own estimate: accountant, fiscalisation, bank. Not a statutory figure.

questions.title: Questions about your legal treatment
questions.foreign: Are all your clients outside Albania (non-resident, with no permanent establishment)?
questions.singleClient: Does a single client give you 80% or more of your income?
questions.twoClients: Do two or fewer clients give you 90% or more of your income?

zero.headline: You keep per month
zero.positive: Profit tax is 0% until {{until}}, so you pay no profit tax on this income. Contributions are a fixed {{contrib}} ALL per month, however much you earn.

reclassified.title: Your income is treated as employment income
reclassified.explain: Under Article 12/1/ç of Law 29/2023, when a single client gives you 80% or more, or two clients give you 90% or more, the income is reclassified as employment income. That means you lose the 0% rate and are taxed at progressive rates under Article 24.
reclassified.estimateNote: This figure comes from the same engine as the salary calculator, but how contributions are treated in this case should be confirmed with an accountant.
reclassified.cta: Calculate it in the salary calculator
reclassified.accountant: You are strongly advised to consult an accountant about your specific situation.

overTurnover.title: Turnover exceeds the {{limit}} ALL ceiling
overTurnover.explain: Above this ceiling the 0% profit tax rate does not apply. The rules above the threshold are more complex and disputed, so this tool does not compute a figure for that case.
overTurnover.accountant: Consult an accountant to determine the correct treatment.

vat.title: You must register for VAT
vat.desc: Annual turnover exceeds the {{threshold}} ALL threshold. B2B services exported to foreign clients are zero-rated, so VAT is not a cost out of pocket, but it is a filing obligation.

example.title: Example: {{income}} ALL per month, all clients outside Albania
example.p1: With annual turnover below {{ceiling}} ALL and only foreign clients, the 0% rate is kept, so profit tax is {{tax}} ALL.
example.p2: Contributions are fixed: {{social}} ALL social insurance plus {{health}} ALL health, {{contrib}} ALL per month in total.
example.p3: With {{admin}} ALL of admin costs, you keep {{net}} ALL out of {{income}} ALL, an effective rate of just {{rate}}.

freelancerCalc.disclaimer: This result is indicative only. Please verify it with an accountant. Based on Albanian law for {{year}}.
freelancerCalc.ctaText: Want to track your income and expenses as a freelancer, all in one place?

salaryCalc.title: Net/Gross Salary Calculator (Albania {{year}})
salaryCalc.intro: Work out net pay from gross, convert net back to gross, or find the full cost to the employer. Rates follow Albanian law for {{year}}.
salaryCalc.metaDescription: Albanian salary calculator for {{year}}. Work out net pay from gross, gross from net, and the total employer cost, including income tax and social and health insurance.
salaryCalc.belowMinimum: This amount falls below the minimum insurance base ({{amount}} ALL). Contributions are charged on that minimum base, so the result does not represent a normal salary.

whenToUse.title: When do you use this calculator?
whenToUse.knowGrossTitle: When you know the gross salary
whenToUse.knowGrossDesc: The figure in a contract or job offer is usually gross. Use Gross → Net to see what actually reaches your hand each month, after tax and contributions.
whenToUse.knowNetTitle: When you know the net salary
whenToUse.knowNetDesc: If you agreed on a take-home amount, or you know it from your payslip, use Net → Gross to find the matching gross salary. Useful when negotiating or comparing two offers.
whenToUse.knowCostDesc: The real cost of an employee is higher than the gross salary, because the employer pays additional contributions. Use Cost → Gross to plan from the total budget you have available.

table.title: Gross to net table for common salaries
table.desc: Monthly values in ALL, using {{year}} rates. Click a row to load it into the calculator.

example.title: How is it calculated? Example for a gross salary of {{gross}} ALL
example.p1: Income tax is charged on the gross salary, not on pay after contributions. For {{gross}} ALL gross, the tax is {{tax}} ALL.
example.p2: Employee contributions are then deducted: social insurance {{socialRate}} or {{social}} ALL, and health insurance {{healthRate}} or {{health}} ALL, {{contribTotal}} ALL in total.
example.p3: Net salary is {{gross}} minus {{tax}} minus {{contribTotal}}, that is {{net}} ALL.
example.p4: On top of that the employer pays {{employerContrib}} ALL in contributions, so the total cost of this salary to them is {{employerCost}} ALL.
example.capNote: Social insurance stops growing above the maximum base of {{cap}} ALL, while health insurance is charged on the whole salary, with no cap.

salaryCalc.disclaimer: This result is indicative only. Please verify it against your payslip. Based on Albanian tax rates for {{year}}.
salaryCalc.ctaText: Want to track your monthly spending too, not just your salary?

loanCalc.title: Loan / Mortgage Calculator (Albania)
loanCalc.intro: Work out the monthly installment on a loan or mortgage, see how much of it is interest, and stress-test it against rate rises and, for euro loans, a stronger euro.
loanCalc.metaDescription: Free loan and mortgage calculator for Albania. Work out the monthly installment, total interest, the effect of a rate rise, euro exchange-rate risk, and how much early repayment saves.

inputs.title: Loan details
inputs.exchangeRateHint: 1 EUR in ALL. An adjustable estimate, not a live rate: enter the rate your bank uses.
inputs.disbursementFeeHint: A one-off fee charged as a share of the loan amount.
inputs.annualInsuranceHint: Life or property insurance the bank requires, per year.
inputs.upfrontCostsHint: Notary, valuation, registration and similar one-off costs.

headline.label: Monthly installment
headline.eurEquivalent: About {{amount}} ALL per month at the rate above

breakdown.title: What the loan costs
breakdown.interestShare: Interest as a share of the amount borrowed
breakdown.totalCostHint: Interest plus fees, insurance and upfront costs. This is an absolute amount, not an APR.

dti.title: Installment vs your income
dti.incomeHint: Optional. Used only to show the installment as a share of your income.
dti.ratio: The installment is {{ratio}} of your net income.
dti.levelOk: This is within the range banks usually consider comfortable.
dti.levelWarn: This is around the level banks often treat as a ceiling.
dti.levelHigh: This is above the level banks usually accept.
dti.orientation: For orientation only. Each bank decides on its own criteria; this is not an approval or a promise.

rateShock.title: If the interest rate rises
rateShock.desc: Most mortgages in Albania have a variable rate, so the installment can move with the market. Here is the installment if your rate rises, and if it falls.
rateShock.descBank: The rate is the reference index plus your bank margin, but it never drops below the floor. Here is the installment as the reference index moves, up and down.

twoPhase.hint: Most Albanian mortgages fix the rate for the first years, then switch to a variable rate for the rest of the term. Banks quote two installments because of it.
twoPhase.change: The installment changes by {{sign}}{{amount}} {{currency}} a month, that is {{pct}}, when the fixed period ends.

property.ltvWarn: Most banks finance up to about 70 to 80% of the property value, so at this level you may need a larger down payment.

dayCount.hint: Banks apply the rate with a days/360 convention, which lands slightly higher than the standard monthly calculation. This is an approximation of that gap, not any bank's exact formula.
dayCount.note: This result is indicative and may differ from a bank offer by roughly 1%, because banks apply a days/360 convention. It is not a contract quote.

fxShock.title: If the euro gets stronger
fxShock.desc: Your loan is in euro but your income is likely in ALL. If the euro strengthens, the same euro installment costs more in ALL. This is the risk to watch on a euro loan.

early.title: Paying off early
early.note: Some banks charge a fee for early repayment. Check your contract before counting on this saving.
early.none: Enter an extra amount above to see how much time and interest you would save.
early.totalPayment: Your required installment stays the same. You would pay {{total}} a month in total ({{base}} required plus {{extra}} extra), which is what shortens the loan below.

schedule.title: Amortization schedule
schedule.desc: How each installment splits between interest and principal over time. Grouped by year.
schedule.explainTitle: Your monthly installment stays the same, but what it pays for changes.
schedule.explainBody: Interest is charged on the balance you still owe, so early on most of the installment is interest and only a little reduces the loan. As the balance falls the interest shrinks and more of each installment goes to the principal, until the balance reaches zero. That is why paying extra in the first years saves the most: it cuts into the balance while the interest is still high.

example.title: Worked example: {{amount}} at {{rate}} over {{years}}
example.p1: A {{amount}} loan at {{rate}} a year over {{years}} works out to an installment of {{payment}} per month.
example.p2: Over the whole term you repay {{totalPaid}}, of which {{interest}} is interest. That is {{share}} of the amount you borrowed, paid on top of it.
example.disclaimer: Results are indicative. Your bank's own offer, rate and fees decide the final figure.

hero.title: Know where you stand, month after month
hero.subtitle: Your bank app lists transactions. A spreadsheet only remembers what you type into it. This tells you where this month stands and whether you are improving, judged against your own history.

features.heading: Judged against your own history, not a generic average

healthscore.title: One number that says if this month is better
healthscore.desc: A 0 to 100 score built from how closely you kept your budgets, how your spending compares to your income, how steady it was month to month, and how many months you finished in the positive.

benchmarks.title: Know what is normal for you, and when you break it
benchmarks.desc: Every category is measured against your own past months, not against strangers. When groceries are flagged as high, it means high for you, and that is the only comparison that should change what you do next.

budgets.title: Find out you are overspending while you can still stop
budgets.desc: Set a limit per category and watch it fill in real time, with a forecast of where the month ends if you keep spending at this pace. You find out you are over while there is still time to do something about it.

tracking.title: A year of your money on one screen
tracking.desc: Log income and expenses by category and see every month side by side, so a bad month is obvious next to the eleven around it. Recurring entries post themselves, so rent and salary are never the thing you forgot.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps to your first score

step1.title: Create an account
step1.desc: Email and a password. No card. Pick your currency and language during setup.

step2.title: Bring in your money
step2.desc: Add transactions, import a CSV from your bank, and set recurring entries for rent and salary so the regular things log themselves.

step3.title: See where you stand
step3.desc: Your dashboard, score, and benchmarks fill in immediately. Each month you add sharpens what normal looks like for you.

privacy.title: A finance app you can actually trust
privacy.desc: Personal finance data is sensitive. Here is exactly what happens to yours, and what does not.

ownership.title: You own your data
ownership.desc: Export everything as CSV any time. Delete your account and the data is gone, permanently, not archived.

encryption.title: Encrypted before it leaves your device
encryption.desc: Amounts, budgets, goals, net worth, transaction titles, tags, and notes are encrypted on your device with a key only you hold. The server stores text it cannot read.

noSell.title: Your data is never sold
noSell.desc: Not sold, not traded, not shared with advertisers. It exists to power your dashboard and nothing else.

noAdvice.title: Analytics, not financial advice
noAdvice.desc: The score and benchmarks describe your own numbers back to you. For decisions with real consequences, talk to a qualified professional.

analytics.title: Privacy-friendly analytics only
analytics.desc: Page counts with no cookies and no cross-site tracking. No advertising pixels anywhere in the app.

payments.title: Card details never reach us
payments.desc: Payments are handled by Paddle. Your card number goes to them, never to this app.

dataPrivacy.title: Nobody can read your numbers
dataPrivacy.desc: Amounts, budgets, goals and net worth are encrypted on your device before they ever leave it. The server only ever stores unreadable text.

device.title: Encrypted on your device
device.desc: The key is generated on your device and never leaves it. All the server receives is ciphertext.

noone.title: Not even we can see them
noone.desc: Without your key the data is unreadable, including to us. That is not a policy promise, it is maths.

yours.title: Always yours
yours.desc: Export everything to CSV or delete all of it, any time. No questions, no delays.

pricingPreview.title: Free to start. Upgrade when you outgrow it.

items.healthscore: Full health score with detailed insights

pricingPreview.trial: Premium starts with a free trial, no card to look around

founder.quote: I built this because I was tired of managing my money in spreadsheets. Not because spreadsheets are bad, they are actually great, but because I wanted something that would just show me the picture without me having to paint it first. Every feature in here exists because I needed it myself.
founder.name: Marin Dulja

free.a: Yes. The free plan needs no credit card and has no time limit: 30 transactions a month, 10 budgets, 10 goals. Premium adds unlimited transactions, cash flow forecasting, and the full score and benchmarks.

albanian.q: Which languages and currencies does it support?
albanian.a: The app is fully translated in English and Albanian. You choose one currency at signup and can change it later in settings, and every screen uses it. There are also free salary, freelancer, and loan calculators built on Albanian rules.

howLong.q: How long until it tells me something useful?
howLong.a: The dashboard and budgets work from your first entries. The score and benchmarks compare you to your own past, so they get sharper with each month of history. Importing a CSV from your bank gives you that history immediately.

encrypted.q: Can your staff see my amounts?
encrypted.a: No. Amounts, budgets, goals and net worth are encrypted on your device with a key only you hold. What reaches the server is encrypted text, so we cannot read it either. If you lose your key and your recovery code, we cannot restore the data either.

switch.q: I already use a spreadsheet. Why switch?
switch.a: Import it as CSV and keep the history. The difference is that this one keeps score without you maintaining formulas, warns you mid-month when a budget is heading over, and tells you how this month compares to your own normal.

advice.a: No. The score, benchmarks, and forecasts describe your own data back to you. They are not professional financial, legal, or tax advice.

multidevice.q: Does it work on my phone?
multidevice.a: Yes, in any modern browser on phone, tablet, or desktop. There is no native app to install.

cancel.q: Can I cancel a paid subscription?
cancel.a: Yes, from your account settings. You keep full access until the end of the billing period, and your data stays exportable whether you pay or not.

section4.title: 4. Payment and Subscription Terms
section4.p1: The Service offers both free and paid subscription plans. Paid plans require valid payment information and will be charged automatically on a recurring basis.
section4.p2: A valid payment method is required to process payments for paid subscriptions. You will provide us or our third-party payment processor (Paddle) with accurate and complete billing information including legal name, address, and valid payment method information.
section4.p3: Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled before the renewal date. You can cancel your subscription at any time through your account settings or subscription management portal.
section4.p4: Free trials may be offered for certain subscription plans. If you do not cancel before the trial period ends, you will be automatically charged for the subscription.

section5.title: 5. Cancellation and Refunds
section5.p1: You may cancel your subscription at any time through your account settings or the subscription management portal. Cancellation stops future renewals - you keep full access until the end of your current billing period. No partial refunds are issued for unused time within an active period.
section5.p2: We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee on your first purchase only. If you are not satisfied, you may request a full refund within 14 days of your initial payment by contacting us. This guarantee does not apply to renewal payments. Refunds are processed through Paddle, our payment processor.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.intro: We collect information you provide directly to us when you create an account, use our Service, or communicate with us. This includes:
section1.item2: Financial transaction data (amounts, categories, dates, descriptions)
section1.item4: Payment information (processed solely by our payment processor, Paddle - we never store or access your payment details)

section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
section2.intro: We use the information we collect to:
section2.item1: Provide, maintain, and improve our Service
section2.item2: Process transactions and send related information
section2.item3: Send technical notices, updates, and support messages
section2.item4: Respond to your comments and questions
section2.item5: Analyze usage patterns to improve user experience

section3.title: 3. Data Storage and Security
section3.p1: Your data is stored securely using Supabase, a PostgreSQL database with enterprise-grade security. We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
section3.p2: However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your personal information, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

section4.title: 4. Payment Processing
section4.content: Payment information is collected and processed solely by Paddle, our third-party payment processor. We never receive, store, or have access to your credit card or payment details. Paddle's privacy policy governs the collection and processing of your payment information.

section5.title: 5. Data Retention
section5.content: We retain your information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services. If you wish to delete your account, please contact us. After account deletion, we may retain certain information as required by law or for legitimate business purposes.

section6.title: 6. Data Sharing
section6.intro: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information only in the following circumstances:
section6.item1: With service providers who assist in our operations (e.g., Paddle for payment processing)
section6.item2: To comply with legal obligations or respond to lawful requests
section6.item3: To protect our rights, privacy, safety, or property
section6.item4: With your consent or at your direction

section7.title: 7. Your Data Rights
section7.item1: Access, update, or delete your personal information
section7.item2: Object to processing of your information
section7.item3: Request restriction of processing your information

section8.title: 8. Children's Privacy
section8.content: Our Service is not intended for children under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18. If you become aware that a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us.

section9.title: 9. Changes to This Privacy Policy
section9.content: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.

section10.title: 10. Contact Us
section10.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through our support channels.

section11.title: 11. Analytics
section11.content: We use GoatCounter, a privacy-friendly analytics tool that uses no cookies and collects no personal data.
